notices.t: Students may apply for one merit-based scholarship scheme and one or more welfare-based scholarship schemes from AY 2026–27, as per scheme eligibility criteria.

OTR is required to apply for scholarship on National Scholarship Portal.

All disabled students must first login in the UDID portal and provide consent to share their UDID details and then submit application in NSP. Otherwise, they will not be able to submit their application.

In such cases students / parents / legal guardians are advised to check
Before proceeding for face authentication through NSP OTR app, kindly ensure that the Biometric Lock / Unlock status should be as “Unlocked” for authentication in Aadhaar.
To lock or unlock the Biometric in Aadhaar, please click on the “Lock/Unlock Aadhaar” option on myAdhaar web portal(please refer to the link:
One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique number allotted to the student
and is applicable for entire academic career on National Scholarship Portal.
OTR can be generated using Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrollment number(EID)
NSP OTR App is available on Google Play Store.
One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique 14-digit number issued
OTR simplifies the scholarship application process, thereby eliminating the need of registration in each academic year.
